scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Global deterministic critical phase-dependent inverse-time infection profile and closed positive amplitude; comparison includes off-threshold global classification.
scientific_integrity.numerical_limit: Finite integrations and quadratures are diagnostic, not infinite-time proofs.
scientific_integrity.support: Analytical derivation with a standalone symbolic and numerical reproducibility script.

scientific_limitations: Deterministic nodewise mean-field SIS, not a finite-state stochastic SIS epidemic.
Explicit critical inverse-time law is restricted to the unique half-period at 1/sqrt(2)<gamma/beta<1.
Does not determine stochastic persistence probability or global answers for general switching graphs.
Unindexed direct specializations of generic periodic epidemic normal forms remain a priority risk.
title: Exact critical decay profile on a three-node alternating-contact SIS path
